text.title: FreshDrop reminder pilot, 2 districts, 50 buyers, 1–21 September 2026
text.hypothesis: buyers in the pilot districts get a fixed slot delivery in time; the reminder lowers missed slots
text.trial: one key feature: the reminder 15 minutes before the slot; the rest done by hand
text.people: 50 buyers from 2 districts, chosen at random among weekly buyers
text.term: 1–21 September 2026; a free slot for each participant
text.criteria: missed slots below 5% (from 14%), by 21 September; the team lead decides
text.numbers: share of participants who kept the slot, and orders per week
text.feedback: «I stopped calling the shop», three people asked for the reminder on all orders
text.decision: scale to all of Moscow if missed slots fall by 20%; otherwise rework the reminder time and repeat
